creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-02 twice in a row running muster-cli's without_a_window::with_no_window_the_daemon_lists_reads_types_into_and_waits_on_its_panes on the Mac mini at load 17 to 26 (other agents' builds), on branch reopen-closed-pane from a6f20f35, whose change does not touch pane send: it failed at without_a_window.rs:679 in a_send_the_pane_never_shows_is_refused. After Ctrl-C ends `cat`, `pane send --pane p1 --enter --confirm 'echo cleared'` exited 4 (unknown: the pane changed without showing the text) where 0 was expected (left Some(4), right Some(0)). It passed on the third run straight after, with the load still around 24.

Likely the same shape as a_2lzok4LKg: the confirm's look races the shell redrawing its prompt after the Ctrl-C, so the line it typed is drawn over before the read-back sees it. Make the case wait for the prompt to be back before it sends, or stage it so the redraw cannot race the look.
title: 🎲 without_a_window's canonical-mode send case sees 'echo cleared' unconfirmed under load
